decision: Exclude the unreferenced alternate data aggregation unit from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file is an assembly aggregation unit that includes msdata.asm and msinit.asm.
No include of msdata2.asm is present in the retained core source trees or frozen selected dependency inventory.
The selected kernel build links msdata, not msdata2; existing project build tools contain no msdata2 reference.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected three-component build and does not establish absence from other DOS configurations.
